author: blu
body: Proves targeted noncreature destruction. "Destroy target artifact or enchantment." compiles to DestroyArtifact (Disenchant), "Destroy target land." to DestroyLand (Stone Rain). Both resolve through the ordinary destruction path; the AI aims Disenchant at the opponent's artifact and Stone Rain at the opponent's land. Applying Disenchant removes the artifact from play.
